title: Age of Mythology: Retold – Update 19.11687
description:
Hello heroes, and welcome to the next update for Age of Mythology: Retold!  This update focuses mostly on bug fixes, such as hotkey issues around production buildings and Oracles, missing Teixiptla upgrade on controller with certain settings enabled, stability fixes, and many other UI and gameplay fixes surrounding our recent new content.

Check out the full list of changes below before jumping into the game to see the changes.

title: Age of Mythology: Retold – Update 19.10938
description:
Welcome heroes to our first update following the exciting launch of Obsidian Mirror! This update focuses on stability, polish, and targeted balance adjustments - alongside fixes and improvements across the Aztec Pantheon, campaign, UI, and a few modding tool adjustments.

Dig down into the notes to see what’s changed before hopping into all the fun in-game!
